backers.name: Nestlé S.A.
backers.note: Nestlé Health Science is Nestlé's dedicated global health-science business unit; it makes strategic investments and acquisitions in nutrition/health companies funded from Nestlé's balance sheet, not a distinct third-party-LP fund.

strategy.thesis: Nestlé's dedicated health-science business unit; per its own site, 'We forge new partnerships, invest in companies with similar goals to us, and acquire companies that complement our global portfolio' — a real, ongoing track record of strategic investments/acquisitions in medical nutrition, healthy-aging and consumer-health companies, distinct from Nestlé's core packaged-food business.

summary.en: Nestlé's dedicated global health-science business unit (HQ Vevey, Switzerland), making ongoing strategic investments and acquisitions in medical nutrition, healthy-aging, and consumer-health companies including Amazentis, Phagenesis, and Dikey Vitamin Group, plus an LP stake in Flagship Pioneering.

sources.title: Nestlé Health Science — About Us / Investments
sources.supports: Named investments (Amazentis, Flagship Pioneering, Phagenesis, Dikey Vitamin Group) and general investment/partnership strategy
sources.quote: We forge new partnerships, invest in companies with similar goals to us, and acquire companies that complement our global portfolio.

verification_notes: Founding year of the business unit not sourced this session — left null rather than guessed. Region set to europe/Switzerland per the confirmed Vevey HQ address, even though the worklist mention surfaced it via a US portfolio company; per instructions the entity's own HQ governs the region/id prefix, not the company page it was found on.
